meta.title: Text in a price cell is refused, not coerced
warnings: the QA memory is not built, so the plan was written without it — run `npm run rag:build`

plan.title: Reject text in vendor price cell

steps.note: Start a new multi-stage event so the RFQ pricing sheet can be configured.
Use an RFQ stage because the case concerns a vendor price cell.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Create one line item so the pricing sheet has a price cell.
Complete the generated pricing sheet before publishing.
Invite the QA vendor needed to test the supplier portal.
Publish the event so the vendor can access its bid sheet.
Confirm the event is available as a real published project.
Move to the supplier portal where the vendor price cell is shown.
Open the event's RFQ bid sheet.
Type text into the price cell and submit; pass only if the portal refuses it, clears it, or leaves submission disabled rather than storing zero.
Return to the buyer console to inspect whether an invalid bid was created.
Assert that no vendor response, including a zero-priced bid, was created.
